subject: Culture
title: The Corset Debate
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Corset Debate.

hook.text: Victorian corsets reduced waists to 18 inches. Some women cracked ribs. Others wore them by choice and loved them.

buildup.text: Corsets shaped European women's bodies for 400 years, from the 1500s to the early 1900s.

discovery.text: Dress reformers called corsets torture devices. But many women resisted reform, insisting corsets felt supportive.

twist.text: Modern waist trainers sell millions on Instagram. The corset never really disappeared—it just rebranded.

climax.text: The debate mirrors a deeper question: when is body modification oppression and when is it self-expression?

punchline.text: The line between constraint and choice is always contested.

quiz.question: How long were corsets a standard garment in European fashion?
